candidates.source_description:
🇺🇸🇬🇧 North Africa, May 1943. Allied ground crews prepare aircraft for another mission as the Allied forces continue their campaign against the Axis in North Africa. Rare WWII archival footage captures the aircraft, mechanics, and preparations behind the scenes before the planes take to the skies. ✈️

A glimpse into the daily operations of the Allied air forces during one of the most important campaigns of World War II.
